basis: pilot_s1 and pilot_s2 (20 runs): peak 0.61-0.63 of the +/-10 V range, 0 rail samples, 0 over-range polls, 0 contiguity breaks; at +/-5 V every full-load step clipped (~150 us per edge)

decimation.design: Kaiser FIR, 80 dB, linear phase, centred

scope.probe_v_per_a: NOT CALIBRATED; 0.100 V/A is a recorded claim; stored data are volts/counts

raw_policy.longer_runs: every:60:10 (10 s of decimated waveform every 60 s from stream start; exact sample-index ranges in *_scope_segments.parquet); continuous envelope always

dcgm.note: kept separate from N; host receipt time only

bmc.sys_power: SDR SYS_POWER polled back to back in its own thread (~1.6 s per query)

alignment: per-run offsets from marker edges: scope threshold crossing of 1 ms v_rms_ac envelope vs CUDA-event GPU times; scope sample index -> host monotonic via lower envelope of poll receipts

reject: scope ADC rail samples in a ~1 ms envelope bin (that bin)
scope driver over-range flag (that poll's samples)
sensor missing, late start or early stop (the uncovered span)
interval_rejection_rule.accounting: rejected time stays in the evaluation denominator and is reported as monitoring unavailability (health_intervals.csv)

test_partition_handling: test-partition recordings get sensor-health validation only; no feature extraction, detector scoring or threshold work on them until detector settings are frozen
